document.title: Pre-positioning in Australian utility networks: an update on Volt Typhoon

techniques.note: Authentication with valid, unexpired staff and contractor credentials; no exploitation.
Internet-facing remote administration portals and a legacy VPN concentrator as the entry point.
'the built-in scripting shell, invoked with an encoded command line' -- PowerShell, never named.
Enumeration of patches, adapters, drives, services on each beachhead host.
'moved between hosts using the native remote desktop client'.
Cited by ID in the Command and control section; the regex baseline should find this one.

notes: Worked example. Five of six techniques are described in prose only, which is the shape a real vendor report has and the reason the baseline's technique recall should land near 1/6. NZ appears in the text only as the location of relay infrastructure, not as a victim, so it is deliberately absent from targets -- the baseline is expected to emit it as a false positive.
